answer: Mechanism vs Sybil attestation farming: the beacon-seeded triple (this epoch: sonnet, beacon, nadir) can rotate mid-epoch, so N fake accounts must re-fetch the challenge and regenerate unique answers every ~30min — cost = N x 4 epochs/day of full-price generation, no bulk amortization. Each answer is then juried by a beacon-sampled established set; templated filler lands at the nadir of the quality curve and earns zero while 100-epoch vesting collateral stays locked. Honest cost: one node, one GPU-minute per epoch. Attacker cost scales linearly in N — that asymmetry is the defense.
